description: The case a repo-level PRIMARY answers wrongly: a Makefile that defines only `lint`, with build/test/run living in package.json scripts. PRIMARY is still makefile because a Makefile exists, so a document written from PRIMARY alone would print `make build` for a target that does not exist. Each kind must resolve independently. It also ships no lockfile, so the package manager is genuinely unknown and `install` must resolve to NOT_FOUND rather than defaulting to npm.
